FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 2
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/09/2023
Senate Bill 2 as introduced would increase the administrative and financial obligations of the
Alabama Department of Public Health (ADPH) by a small undetermined amount to create a
stand-alone page on ADPH's website explaining the health care facility visitation requirements
established by this bill.
